summary: Dataset passes all hard rules. No PII leaks, zero duplicates, 100% source URL coverage. Six minor quality issues documented below — none are blockers, but all are noted for compliance-officer review and downstream consumer awareness.

hard_rules_check.public_data_only: PASS — sourced from FMCSA Company Census File via DOT Open Data Portal (data.transportation.gov). No auth required, federal open data policy.
hard_rules_check.no_pii: PASS — no SSN patterns detected. Dataset contains business contact data (business email, business phone, physical business address) consistent with FMCSA public records. Personal-domain emails (78.7%) are owner-operator contacts published voluntarily in public federal filings — not private PII.
hard_rules_check.source_url_on_every_row: PASS — 0 rows missing source_url (15,770 / 15,770 filled). All URLs point to SAFER FMCSA CompanySnapshot and DOT number in URL matches row dot_number.
hard_rules_check.production_code_only: N/A — data quality gate, not code review.
hard_rules_check.no_private_datasets: PASS — FMCSA Company Census File is a federally mandated public disclosure dataset.

issues.description: 169 rows (1.1%) contain undocumented fleetsize codes beyond the expected A–E scale. Codes seen: I(22), F(46), J(21), G(26), H(10), K(7), L(9), M(4), N(4), O(7), P(1), Q(1), R(1), S(1), T(1), Z(8). These likely represent legacy MCMIS encoding variants or special classifications in the upstream FMCSA data. Additionally, 2,282 rows use '0' as a fleetsize code (undocumented in metadata — probable upstream encoding for 'not reported').
issues.recommendation: Treat all non A–E codes as 'unknown' fleet size in downstream products. Add a decoded column (fleetsize_label) mapping A→'1-6 vehicles', B→'7-20', C→'21-100', D→'101-500', E→'501+', else→'Unknown'. Do not suppress these rows.

issues.description: 240 rows (1.5%) have non-US state codes — primarily Canadian provinces (ON=110, QC=23, AB=28, BC=16, SK=10, MB=6) and a small number of Mexican state codes (TA=12, CI=8, CH=4, etc.) plus a few unrecognized codes. FMCSA does register foreign carriers operating in the US under NAFTA/CUSMA agreements, so this is expected upstream data, not an error.
issues.recommendation: Add a 'country' field derived from phy_state: US states → 'US', Canadian province codes → 'CA', Mexican state codes → 'MX', unknown → 'UNKNOWN'. For the leads product, flag these rows so buyers can filter by country if needed.

issues.description: 6 rows have phone numbers that are not 10-digit US format. Details: DOT 4567692 (XCEL LOGISOLUTIONS LLC): '919820888264' [12-digit, India +91]; DOT 4564627 (SABR LOGISTICS LLC): '12624558883' [11-digit, US+1 prefix]; DOT 4564818 (ZNJ TRANSPORTS LLC): '6596653' [7-digit, incomplete]; DOT 4562155 (TUCKERSUSA): '447986000940' [12-digit, UK +44]; DOT 4562187 (FIVE GT TOWERS LLC): '16786204300' [11-digit, US+1 prefix]; DOT 4561537 (WEST COAST CARRIER SERVICES LLC): '65662470189' [11-digit, Singapore +65].
issues.recommendation: Flag these 6 rows with phone_valid=false. Do not suppress. The US+1-prefix numbers can be cleaned by stripping the leading 1. International numbers should be preserved as-is but flagged.

issues.description: 1 row with likely typo email domain: DOT 4576645 (FRED NATIONAL LLC): FREDNATIONALLLC@GMAOL.COM — 'gmaol.com' is almost certainly a typo for 'gmail.com'.
issues.recommendation: Flag with email_suspect=true. Do not auto-correct (we cannot verify intent). Buyer should be aware this email is likely undeliverable.

issues.description: 176 rows (1.1%) have an empty carrier_operation code. This field classifies carrier type (A=authorized-for-hire, C=private, B=passenger, etc.). Empty likely means not yet classified in MCMIS at time of extract.
issues.recommendation: Retain rows. Add carrier_operation_label column; empty code maps to 'Unclassified'.

issues.description: 255 rows are non-active: 215 Inactive (I) and 40 Pending (P). For a leads product, inactive carriers are less valuable but pending carriers (just applied, not yet active) may be highly valuable early-bird contacts.
issues.recommendation: Retain all rows. Expose status_code in the product so buyers can filter. Consider marketing Pending (P) rows as premium early-stage leads.

notes: All six issues are minor data quality observations inherited from the upstream FMCSA source. None constitute a compliance failure, PII exposure, or missing source URL. Dataset is cleared to proceed to compliance-officer review. Recommend engineer adds decoded helper columns (fleetsize_label, country, phone_valid, email_suspect) before shipping.
